name: mcp-web-validator
description: Validate HTML/CSS, audit SEO and JSON-LD, check links, and capture responsive screenshots.

tools.name: html.local
tools.description: Reads a bounded local HTML file and sends its markup to the W3C Nu HTML Checker. Use only files the user is authorized to share.

tools.name: html.url
tools.description: Fetches a bounded public HTTP(S) page, then sends its markup to the W3C Nu HTML Checker. Private, reserved, credentialed, and nonstandard-port destinations are rejected.

tools.name: css.local
tools.description: Reads a bounded local CSS file and sends it to the W3C Jigsaw CSS Validator. Use only files the user is authorized to share.

tools.name: seo.metadata
tools.description: Analyzes supplied HTML locally for metadata, heading structure, viewport configuration, image alternatives, and Open Graph fields.

tools.name: links.broken
tools.description: Resolves and checks up to 25 public HTTP(S) links in supplied HTML. Redirects are reported but not followed, and response bodies are discarded.

tools.name: schema.markup
tools.description: Parses JSON-LD blocks in supplied HTML locally and reports empty blocks or JSON syntax errors. It does not validate vocabulary semantics.

tools.name: report.validation
tools.description: Combines W3C HTML/CSS validation, local SEO/accessibility checks, JSON-LD syntax checks, and a bounded public-link check into a Markdown and structured report.

tools.name: screenshot.capture
tools.description: Renders a local HTML file or HTTP(S) URL in a sandboxed local Chromium browser and writes PNG screenshots to the requested directory. Existing matching files may be replaced.
